claims.claim: Gordon opens her study by asserting that Wolfe writes elegant and evocative prose.

claims.claim: Andre-Driussi reports Wolfe denying that the Lexicon's entries were guesses, saying instead that Andre-Driussi looks things up.

claims.quote: No, not at all – he looks things up!
claims.page: interview, reply on the 1991 World Fantasy Convention

claims.claim: The Ultan's Library interviewer describes one of Wolfe's naming schemes in the Urth Cycle as naming people in the Commonwealth after Catholic saints.
claims.source: Ultan's Library (interviewer), interview with Michael Andre-Driussi, 2008
claims.quote: naming people in the Commonwealth after Catholic saints

claims.claim: Andre-Driussi says one of the Lexicon's special articles is a history that puts all the posthistorical bits of the Urth Cycle into one place.
claims.source: Michael Andre-Driussi, interview in Ultan's Library, 2008
claims.quote: putting together all the posthistorical bits into one place

claims.claim: Andre-Driussi says it took him eight years to sell all 1,000 copies of the first edition of Lexicon Urthus.

claims.quote: it took me eight years to sell all 1,000 copies!
